extractSha256Note: SHA-256 of build/fixture/basemap.pmtiles, the artefact this build produces. This is the integrity signal: the pin's blake3 identifies the 137 GB upstream and is compared against its published metadata row, which is not source-byte verification. The build fails before promotion if the extract does not hash to this, so a change in the upstream, the tile set or the metadata cannot land silently.
retentionNote: The daily bucket keeps the past week plus the final build of each superseded patch version. This is v4.15.1's final build, so it stays addressable; the pin has aged out exactly when its row is no longer listed in metadataUrl, which the build fails on by name.
